factors.combined_score: equal mean of the repository cross-sectional z-scores
factors.selection: five highest combined scores among jointly valid assets

fixed_candidates.equal_weight_top5: 20 percent target weight for each of the five selected assets
fixed_candidates.inverse_volatility_top5: inverse trailing-20-session adjusted-close volatility among the five selected assets, normalized and capped at 30 percent

execution.frequency: weekly on the frozen core portfolio decision calendar
execution.signal_observation: latest completed market session on or before the weekly decision date
execution.trade_timing: target learned at one weekly decision is first entered at the following weekly close and earns returns only after that close
execution.turnover: half L1 change from drifted pre-trade holdings, including cash

controls.inverted_ranking: select the five lowest combined scores

promotion_gates.primary_performance: 50-bps annual return positive, Sharpe at least 0.50, and maximum drawdown no worse than -35 percent
promotion_gates.later_windows: 50-bps annual return positive in validation and retrospective-test windows
promotion_gates.controls: 50-bps candidate Sharpe strictly exceeds stale-1, stale-5, inverted, and asset-permutation controls
promotion_gates.blend: 80/20 blend Sharpe exceeds common-period core, drawdown is no worse by more than two percentage points, and familywise paired Sharpe lower bound is positive

interpretation.portfolio_status_if_historical_gates_pas: research challenger only until a new untouched 52-week forward record completes
